findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_london_districts, get_district_profile · Public sink: find_london_districts, get_district_profile, compare_london_districts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_london_districts, get_district_profile · Public sink: find_london_districts, get_district_profile, compare_london_districts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
